entities.summary: Florent Michel Marie Joseph du Bois de La Villerabel, archbishop of Aix, Arles and Embrun (1940–1944), was the most prominent of seven French mainland or colonial bishops who, in the aftermath of the Liberation, were obliged to submit their resignations to Pope Pius XII because of their close collaboration with the Germans during the German occupation of France from 1940 to 1944.
